name: anofox-forecast-wasm-tests
description: DuckDB-Wasm smoke/regression harness for the anofox_forecast extension.
comment: This pin matches the wasm_eh artifact this harness tests, which is the v1.5.6 line: 1.33.1-dev65.0 bundles engine v1.5.6 (verified via the storage-version list in dist/duckdb-eh.wasm). The stable line is DuckDB v2.0.0, but as of 2026-10-22 no @duckdb/duckdb-wasm build bundles v2.0.0 (the newest is 1.33.1-dev65.0). When one ships, bump this pin and repoint the CI jobs to the v2.0.0 artifact together.
